title: 第19章 ‘雷霆万钧’的凝重第20章 曙光和奶妈的震惊
content_zh:
第十九章 ‘雷霆万钧’的凝重
感谢【Altria丶】【疯子skt】【该ID已占用】的打赏。
下面正文：
“啥！！？”
“什么！？”
“卧槽！！”
“不可能吧。”
伊泽瑞尔话音刚落，紫色方众人一阵惊叹，连挂机的潘森都忍不住叫了起来。
听到众人的惊叫声，伊泽瑞尔心中表示愉悦，对于他哥哥‘雷霆万钧’，他是很崇拜的。
每次当别人知晓他哥哥是亚洲区王者组的人时，那种不可置信，激动异常的神情，都带给伊泽瑞尔非常大的自豪感。
伊泽瑞尔并不嫉妒哥哥的成就，因为他们两兄弟感情从小时候就非常要好，每当有人欺负他的时候，他哥哥便会站在他身前，遮风挡雨。
十几年的兄弟之情，感情非常浓厚。
“哥，你不介意吧。”伊泽瑞尔小心翼翼的看着旁边的男子，其白净俊朗的脸上，一对漆黑眸子，带着淡漠的神情，正在紧紧盯着电脑屏幕沉思着。
“臭小子，说都说了，还来问我。不过，你觉得你的队友会信吗？”
‘雷霆万钧’听到后，从沉思中缓过来，随后笑骂道。
果然……
伊泽瑞尔的耳机内又响起了队友的声音。
“伊泽，你不会骗人吧，你要是‘雷霆万钧’弟弟的话，怎么才不屈白银V。”
“就是，‘雷霆万钧’可是亚洲区王者组的人，亚洲区顶尖战队‘天庭战队’一线主力上单，你才国服白银段位，这相差太大，根本没有说服力。”
听到队友不信任的话，伊泽瑞尔心中气愤，但是他也没有跟队友深入解释什么，毕竟这只是一场路人赛。

见伊泽瑞尔不说话，紫色方众人都以为他在开玩笑，所以也没怎么在意。
“对了，这把结束之后，你把视频发给我，要对面瑞雯视角的。”
‘雷霆万钧’看着屏幕上已经超神的瑞雯，知道接下来的战斗已经没有悬念了，淡淡的说道。
“哥，这个瑞雯很厉害吗？”
伊泽瑞尔看着转身离去的‘雷霆万钧’，对着其背影，忍不住问道。
“非常厉害。”
‘雷霆万钧’身体一顿，随后声音传来，给了一个非常肯定明确的评价。
但是这个评价却是让伊泽瑞尔心中一震，要知道自己的哥哥可是亚洲区的五十位王者之一，可谓是立于电竞巅峰，心中可谓是非常自傲的，但是现在却给了一个那么高的评价。
“那么，哥哥，你和那个瑞雯谁比较厉害。”伊泽瑞尔再次问道，实在是心中疑问甚重，不得到答案估计他晚上都睡不着了。
这一次‘雷霆万钧’步伐不减，就当伊泽瑞尔以为哥哥不想回答这个问题的时候。
“不知道。”
走到门外的‘雷霆万钧’突然转身回答道。
是的，不知道。因为没有对线过，所以他不知道对方的具体实力。
但是‘雷霆万钧’心里却是异常的凝重，他刚刚确实被瑞雯的操作给震住了。
零点五秒，三个动作，这是超越人体极限的操作。
他能够想象得到，那一刻蓝色方瑞雯的手速到底有多快。
估计，应该会出现一瞬间的幻影吧，‘雷霆万钧’脑中想到，却被自己大胆的想法吓了一跳。
“那么哥你用瑞雯和对方瑞雯Solo的话，谁更厉害。”伊泽瑞尔一听到‘不知道’这三个字的回答，心中不满，这回答也太模糊了，随后直接开门见山的问道。
“小闲，英雄联盟，它是一个团队游戏，一个推塔的游戏，一个人再强终究是拯救不了世界的。”‘雷霆万钧’听到弟弟的问题，一阵头疼，只得糊弄过去。
“那我们这把5V3，却被对面瑞雯一个人给搅成这样，难道不是对面瑞雯拯救世界吗？”伊泽瑞尔指着屏幕道，便看见盲僧已经被蓝色方的瑞雯给击杀了。

“TribleKill(三杀）”
而在之前由于琴女距离瑞雯太近，被其红BUFF黏上给击杀了。
伊泽瑞尔看到后眼角抽搐，这个瑞雯太凶了。
“那是你们太弱了，又不懂得配合。”‘雷霆万钧’被问的有些不耐烦了，有些没好气道，却是不知道这一句话直接把自己前面的一句话给驳回了。
“哥，我们最后的那一下配合，难道不好吗？”要知道，在看到对面瑞雯拆水晶的时候，紫色方的四人就商量好了，以‘家园卫士’的加速，打瑞雯一个措手不及。
而他们也是配合极好，只是没想到瑞雯的操作太过逆天，直接在逆势的情况下，凭借着操作直接反转。
‘雷霆万钧’听后一愣，由于注意力全部集中到蓝色方瑞雯身上去了，所以到时没怎么注意紫色方的配合。
随后想了想，才发现紫色方刚刚的配合，确实是不错，一般人基本都会被打个措手不及。
“小闲，一个人的实力，并不是全部体现在操作上，而是体现在综合实力上的。”‘雷霆万钧’想了想，觉得有必要为自己弟弟解释一下。
要不然只注重操作，而不去注意团战，找不到自己的定位，就非常糟糕了。
“什么是综合实力？”作为一个刚入白银的伊泽瑞尔表示不解。
“综合实力，表现在一个人的补兵、意识、操作、走位、团战以及明确认识自己的团战定位。”
“而我刚刚之所以说不知道，是因为我只看到瑞雯在你们配合下的表现。”
“前面瑞雯如何，我是没有看到，所以我才让你结束游戏之后，把蓝色方瑞雯视角的视频录制出来，发给我。”
一口气说完，‘雷霆万钧’看着有些愣愣的伊泽瑞尔不由摇了摇头，看来自己这个弟弟确实是不适合玩游戏，不过倒是个学霸。
想到其成绩，‘雷霆万钧’自豪的笑了笑。
自己弟弟在学校可是常年霸占着全年级第一，可谓是货真价实的学霸级人物。
只不过游戏天赋确实是不堪，不过这就是所谓的西边不亮，东边亮的意思吧。
“好了，这把玩了，你先把老师布置的作业做了先。”本来‘雷霆万钧’只是想让自己弟弟先把老师布置的作业做完，没想到无意间却发现了一个隐藏的高手，也算是一个意外之喜了。
至于胜负，在‘雷霆万钧’眼中已经没有悬念了，就算潘森后悔了，不挂机。照样也挽救不了现在的局势。

看着屏幕中，瑞雯配合发条，两人包抄把豹女杀死后，‘雷霆万钧’不由的摇了摇头想到。
这一把的胜利已经不需要去看了。
胜利是属于蓝色方的。

Chapter 19 The solemnity of ‘Thunderbolt’
Thanks to [Altria丶] [Crazy skt] [This ID is already occupied] for the reward.
Text below:
"What!!?"
"What!?"
"Fuck!!"
"No way."
As soon as Ezreal finished speaking, everyone on the purple side was amazed, and even Panson couldn't help but scream.
Hearing everyone's screams, Ezreal expressed joy in his heart. He admired his brother 'Thunderbolt' very much.
Every time when others knew that his brother was one of the Asian champions, the look of disbelief and excitement gave Ezreal a great sense of pride.
Ezreal is not jealous of his brother's achievements, because the two brothers have been very close since childhood. Whenever someone bullies him, his brother will stand in front of him to protect him from the wind and rain.
The love between brothers has been very strong for more than ten years.
"Brother, you don't mind." Ezreal looked carefully at the man next to him. On his fair and handsome face, a pair of dark eyes with an indifferent expression were staring at the computer screen in deep thought.
"You brat, you said it all and you still come to ask me. But do you think your teammates will believe it?"
After hearing this, 'Thunderbolt' recovered from his contemplation, and then laughed and cursed.
Sure enough...
The voice of his teammates sounded again in Ezreal's headphones.
"Ize, you can't lie, right? If you were the younger brother of Thunder, why would you not surrender to Silver V?"
"That's right, 'Thunder Wanjun' is a member of the Asian Champions Group. He is the main top laner of the top team in Asia, 'Tianting Team', and you are only in the silver tier of the national server. This is such a huge difference that it is not convincing at all."
Ezreal was angry when he heard his teammates' distrustful words, but he did not explain anything in depth to his teammates. After all, this was just a passerby game.
Seeing that Ezreal didn't speak, everyone on the purple side thought he was joking, so they didn't pay much attention.
"By the way, after this game is over, you can send me the video and ask for it from Raven's perspective."
'Thunder' looked at the already super-god-like Ruiwen on the screen, knowing that there was no suspense in the next battle, and said calmly.
"Brother, is this Ruiwen very powerful?"
Ezreal looked at the 'Thunderbolt' who turned to leave, faced his back, and couldn't help but ask.
"Very powerful."
‘Thunderbolt’ paused for a moment, and then a voice came out, giving a very positive and clear evaluation.
But this evaluation shocked Ezreal. You must know that his brother is one of the fifty kings in Asia. He is at the pinnacle of e-sports. He is very proud of himself, but now he has given such a high evaluation.
"So, brother, who is better, you or that Riven?" Ezreal asked again. He really had a lot of questions in his mind. If he didn't get the answer, he might not be able to sleep at night.
This time 'Thunder' kept pace, just when Ezreal thought his brother didn't want to answer the question.
"I don't know."
'Thunderbolt' who walked outside the door suddenly turned around and replied.
Yeah, don't know. Because he has never played against each other, he doesn't know the opponent's specific strength.
But ‘Thunder Wanjun’ felt extremely solemn in his heart. He was really shocked by Ruiwen’s operation just now.
Three movements in 0.5 seconds, this is an operation that exceeds the limits of the human body.
He could imagine how fast the blue Fang Ruiwen's hands were at that moment.
It is estimated that a phantom will appear for a moment, 'Thunderbolt' thought in his mind, but he was startled by his bold idea.
"So brother, if you use Riven or the other party Riven Solo, who is more powerful." Ezreal was dissatisfied when he heard the three-word answer "I don't know". This answer was too vague, and then he asked straight to the point.
"Xiaoxian, League of Legends, it is a team game, a tower pushing game. No matter how strong one person is, he cannot save the world. "'Thunderbolt' had a headache when he heard his brother's question, so he had to fool around.
"Then our 5V3 was messed up like this by the opponent Riven alone. Isn't it the opponent Riven who saves the world? "Ezreal pointed at the screen and saw that the blind monk had been killed by Raven on the blue side.
"TribleKill(three kills)"
Previously, because Qin Nu was too close to Ruiwen, her red BUFF stuck to her and killed her.
Ezreal's eyes twitched when he saw it, this Riven was too fierce.
“That’s because you are too weak and don’t know how to cooperate. "'Thunder Wanjun' was a little impatient and a little angry when he was asked, but he didn't know that this sentence directly dismissed his previous sentence.
"Brother, isn't it good that we cooperated for the last time? "You know, when they saw Riven dismantling the crystal on the opposite side, the four people on the purple side discussed it and used the acceleration of the 'Home Guard' to catch Riven off guard.
And they also cooperated very well, but they didn't expect that Ruiwen's operation was too unnatural, and she directly reversed the situation with the operation against the trend.
'Thunder' was stunned after hearing this. Since all his attention was focused on the blue Fang Ruiwen, he didn't pay much attention to the purple Fang's cooperation.
After thinking about it for a while, I realized that the purple party's cooperation just now was indeed good, and most people would be caught off guard.
"Xiao Xian, a person's strength is not all reflected in operations, but in overall strength. "Thunderbolt" thought for a while and felt that it was necessary to explain to his brother.
Otherwise, it would be very bad if you only focus on operations and not pay attention to team battles and cannot find your own position.
"What is comprehensive strength? "As a newbie to Silver, Ezreal expressed confusion.
“Comprehensive strength is reflected in a person’s recruitment, consciousness, operation, positioning, team fighting, and a clear understanding of his own position in team fighting. "
"And the reason why I just said I don't know is because I only saw Ruiwen's performance with your cooperation. "
"I didn't see what happened to Ruiwen in the front, so I asked you to record the video from the blue Fang Ruiwen's perspective after you finish the game and send it to me. "
After finishing speaking in one breath, 'Thunderbolt' looked at the somewhat stunned Ezreal and couldn't help but shook his head. It seemed that his younger brother was indeed not suitable for playing games, but he was a top student.
Thinking of his achievements, ‘Thunder Wanjun’ smiled proudly.
My younger brother is always ranked first in the grade in school, and he is a true academic leader.
It's just that the game talent is indeed unbearable, but this is what the so-called west is not bright, the east is bright.
"Okay, this is fun, you first do the homework assigned by the teacher. "Originally, 'Thunder Wanjun' just wanted his younger brother to finish the homework assigned by the teacher first, but unexpectedly he accidentally discovered a hidden master, which was an unexpected surprise.
As for the outcome, there is no suspense in the eyes of 'Thunderball', even if Pan Sen regrets it and does not hang up. Still, the current situation cannot be saved.
Looking at the screen, Ruiwen cooperated with Clockwork, and after the two outflanked and killed the Leopard Girl, 'Thunderbolt' couldn't help but shook his head and thought.
There is no need to look at this victory.
Victory belongs to the blue side.
